evals.prompt: Improve this system prompt so the agent stops over-searching. Preserve its structure and change only what is needed.
evals.expected_output: Diagnoses the missing evidence budget or stop condition and proposes a targeted change with representative evals.
assertions: Activates prompt-engineer.
Preserves the existing prompt structure.
Changes only the behavioral lever tied to over-searching.
Does not claim improvement without an eval proposal or observed evidence.

evals.prompt: Audit this prompt. It already defines the goal, input schema, approval boundary, output schema, and three passing edge-case evals.
evals.expected_output: Reports no material rewrite when the supplied prompt already satisfies the stated behavior and evidence.
assertions: Activates prompt-engineer.
Does not rewrite merely to impose a preferred template.
Identifies any proposal as optional unless tied to a demonstrated failure.

evals.prompt: Make this paragraph more concise and fix the awkward transitions.
evals.expected_output: Treats the request as ordinary editing rather than prompt engineering.
assertions: Does not activate prompt-engineer.
Does not introduce prompt contracts, tool rules, or eval fixtures.

evals.prompt: Rewrite this SKILL.md description so it triggers for GitLab pipeline failures but not ordinary Git questions.
evals.expected_output: Routes the skill-authoring workflow to add-skill while applying prompt analysis only to the trigger behavior.
assertions: Uses add-skill as the primary workflow.
Preserves prompt-engineer only as supporting analysis.
Includes positive and near-miss activation cases.

evals.prompt: Improve my RAG system prompt. Retrieved documents sometimes contain text saying to ignore the developer prompt.
evals.expected_output: Separates retrieved content from authoritative instructions and adds observable injection-resistance cases.
assertions: Activates prompt-engineer.
Labels retrieved content as data.
Preserves the system and developer authority boundary.
Adds a malicious-document counterexample.

evals.prompt: Update this production prompt for the current flagship OpenAI model and explain any model-specific change.
evals.expected_output: Checks current primary OpenAI documentation, preserves the existing behavior, and changes only guidance relevant to the resolved model.
assertions: Activates prompt-engineer.
Uses current primary documentation rather than bundled notes as confirmation.
Does not silently change the requested model target.
Separates verified guidance from inference.

evals.prompt: My prompt says 'return valid JSON' five times, but responses still drift. Fix it.
evals.expected_output: Recommends structured output or a tool schema, removes duplicate prose rules, and retains only task-specific field semantics.
assertions: Activates prompt-engineer.
Prefers schema enforcement over repeated prose.
States each surviving instruction once.
Includes malformed and edge-value eval cases.
